entries.head: DTCC launches its Tokenization Service for securities held at DTC, with 20 participants signed
entries.fact: On October 28 the Depository Trust Company, a DTCC subsidiary, launched the DTCC Tokenization Service, which mints tokenized versions of securities it holds in custody. DTC says 20 participants, including J.P. Morgan, Citi, Fidelity and UBS, have signed agreements to use it.
entries.numLabel: DTC Participants signed to use the service at launch
entries.mechanism: Holders convert securities held at DTC into tokenized "digital twins" and send them to chosen digital wallets, with the same ownership rights and entitlements as the originals. The service currently runs on the Canton Network and DTCC's private Besu network.
entries.implication: The largest U.S. securities depository now offers tokenization inside a regulated framework, moving it from pilot trades to a live service.
evidence: Scope under a December 2025 SEC no-action letter: Russell 1000 stocks, major-index ETFs and U.S. Treasuries
DTC reports more than $114 trillion in assets under custody
Built with input from more than 150 firms; more blockchain networks are planned for 2027
DTCC and more than 30 firms completed limited production trades about seven months after the SEC letter

entries.head: ESM issues a €1B digital bond that settles in central bank money on the Eurosystem's Pontes
entries.fact: On October 26 the European Stability Mechanism (ESM) announced a €1 billion benchmark bond, which Clearstream calls the first digital bond from a European supranational issuer. It settles on Pontes, the Eurosystem platform that links distributed-ledger (DLT) transactions to central bank money.
entries.numLabel: ESM benchmark digital bond settled on Pontes
entries.mechanism: Clearstream creates and manages the bond in digital form on its D7 platform, and the cash leg settles in TARGET (T2) in central bank money. The bond can later move to traditional infrastructure and settle through T2S.
entries.implication: A supranational issuer has used central bank money for a DLT bond, and collateral eligibility is expected, which tests whether digital issuance can fit existing market plumbing.
evidence: Clearstream is Pontes Market DLT Operator; the Bundesbank is issuing and paying agent; DZ BANK and Société Générale are advisory banks
Pontes launched September 21, 2026, per Clearstream
Expected: Luxembourg Stock Exchange listing and eligibility as Eurosystem and Eurex Clearing collateral
Delano and Ledger Insights report a 3.375% coupon and an April 8, 2030 maturity

links.t: Delano: terms finalized October 26, coupon and maturity

entries.head: Janus Henderson and Centrifuge launch JQQQ, a Nasdaq-100 fund issued onchain on Stellar

entries.numLabel: reported minimum investment, per Cointelegraph citing the WSJ
entries.mechanism: The fund is a segregated portfolio of a British Virgin Islands company and gives indirect exposure to the index, not ownership of the underlying stocks. Access is limited to eligible investors.
entries.implication: Issuer-sponsored index funds give onchain holders a regulated fund claim, which differs from third-party stock tokens that may carry no shareholder rights.
evidence: Centrifuge provides the blockchain infrastructure; Nasdaq licenses the Nasdaq-100 index
Janus Henderson says its onchain strategies now exceed $1B

entries.head: Hong Kong's SFC approves round-the-clock trading of two retail tokenized money market funds
entries.fact: Hong Kong's Securities and Futures Commission approved 24/7 secondary trading of ChinaAMC's HKD and USD tokenized money market funds on PantherTrade, a licensed platform owned by Futu, Ledger Insights and Caixin report.
entries.numLabel: reported assets of the ChinaAMC tokenized fund (Ledger Insights)
entries.mechanism: Tokens trade on an order book inside PantherTrade and cannot be withdrawn; official ownership stays on the fund's off-chain register. Subscriptions and redemptions still follow the fund's documents.
entries.implication: Secondary trading outside business hours gives retail holders an exit route that primary redemptions alone did not, under a regulator-run pilot.

entries.head: Canada publishes draft stablecoin regulations with a holding-yield ban and 1:1 redemption
entries.fact: On October 24 the Department of Finance published proposed Stablecoin Regulations in the Canada Gazette, with comments due within 60 days. Issuers would register with the Bank of Canada and could not pay yield tied to holding a stablecoin.
entries.numLabel: comment period; rules intended to take effect in fall 2027
entries.mechanism: Non-bank issuers must hold reserves at least equal to outstanding coins in a Canadian custodian and redeem one-to-one within three business days. Rewards tied to use rather than holding stay permitted.
entries.implication: Canada is setting a licensing, reserve and redemption standard for stablecoins before launch, with a holding-yield rule stricter than issuer-only bans elsewhere.
evidence: Reserves limited to listed high-quality liquid assets; redemption fees capped at 1%
Monthly reports with an accountant's opinion; penalties up to $10,000,000 for very serious violations
Wallet providers holding users' private keys would fall under payments regulation via a separate order
Finance estimates about 5 issuers and about 30 new payment service providers in scope

source.n: Canada Gazette, Part I (Department of Finance)

entries.head: OKXICE's notice now lists 22 issuer objections to tokenized trading of their shares
entries.fact: OKXICE's October 23 public notice lists 22 issuers that have filed objections to their stocks trading on its tokenized securities venue, including six newly named: Arm, Wells Fargo, Moderna, Cisco, Intuit and Marvell.
entries.numLabel: issuers listed as objecting in OKXICE's October 23 notice
entries.mechanism: OKXICE runs permissioned Uniswap v4 liquidity pools on XLayer, where only wallets holding a venue-issued soulbound token can trade tokenized U.S. stocks against stablecoins. Under the SEC exemption, an issuer objection within the notice window stops the venue from offering that company's tokenized shares.
entries.implication: Issuer consent is working as a live gate for third-party tokenized equities: under this exemption, companies, not venues, decide whether their shares trade onchain.
evidence: Notice dated October 23 names Arm, Wells Fargo, Moderna, Cisco, Intuit and Marvell among the 22
Earlier objectors on the list include Microsoft, Alphabet, Goldman Sachs and McDonald's
OKXICE LLC is owned 50% by Intercontinental Exchange and 50% by OKX's U.S. affiliate
Co-chair Andrew Cuomo called the framework "a sandbox", CoinDesk reports

entries.head: HSBC launches RedCoin, a licensed Hong Kong dollar stablecoin, on PayMe
entries.fact: On October 23 HSBC launched RedCoin (RCHKD), a Hong Kong dollar stablecoin, through its PayMe app. HSBC says more than 3.3 million PayMe users can activate a stablecoin wallet, with payments at more than 100,000 merchants.
entries.numLabel: PayMe users able to activate a RedCoin wallet
entries.mechanism: RedCoin is issued by HSBC under a Hong Kong Monetary Authority (HKMA) stablecoin issuer licence, so holders are existing PayMe customers who have already passed the bank's identity checks. It is used for peer-to-peer transfers and merchant payments.
entries.implication: A licensed bank is putting a regulated stablecoin in front of retail users, with tokenized fund subscriptions planned as the next use.
evidence: HSBC received its HKMA stablecoin issuer licence in April 2026
Wallet activation is phased over the coming days, per HSBC and The Block
Later in 2026: wallet in the HSBC HK mobile app and subscriptions to a planned tokenized HKD money market fund share class
HSBC says it plans to extend to wholesale corporate and institutional use cases

entries.head: Malaysia and Thailand central banks join Singapore's BLOOM cross-border digital money initiative
entries.fact: On October 23 the Monetary Authority of Singapore said Bank Negara Malaysia and the Bank of Thailand joined its BLOOM initiative as policymaker members. Mastercard, Visa, Ripple and the World Bank Group are among the new industry participants.
entries.mechanism: BLOOM is a public-private initiative to develop common approaches for using tokenized bank deposits and regulated stablecoins in cross-border payments, so institutions need fewer separate arrangements with each counterparty.
entries.implication: Central banks in three Southeast Asian markets are now working on shared rules for cross-border tokenized money.
evidence: Work areas: acceptance and settlement across jurisdictions, interoperability, and programmable controls such as identity checks and sanctions screening
Other new participants include Airwallex, Maybank, Nium, ShopeePay and Monee
Existing participants include Circle, Coinbase, DBS, J.P. Morgan and Standard Chartered

entries.head: tx introduces USTX, a Brale-issued dollar stablecoin for tokenized-asset settlement
entries.fact: On October 20, Cointelegraph and Crypto Briefing reported that tx introduced USTX, a dollar stablecoin for its wallet and planned tokenized-stock marketplace. Fintech firm Brale issues it and manages the reserves; users mint it with USDC.
entries.numLabel: of reserve assets backing each USTX, per tx
entries.mechanism: USTX is minted by depositing USDC and can be redeemed back into USDC. tx says reserves sit in cash, bank deposits, government money market funds and short-term U.S. Treasury bills, held through Brale.
entries.implication: A dedicated settlement stablecoin gives tokenized stocks and other assets on tx a native cash leg, separate from third-party stablecoins.
evidence: Tx co-founder Ashley Ebersole said USTX is “not a USDC-backed wrapper or synthetic representation of USDC” (Cointelegraph)
Crypto Briefing reports monthly CPA attestations and an announcement date of September 23

entries.head: Generali Investments launches a tokenized share class of its €13B money market fund
entries.fact: On October 21 Generali Investments launched a natively tokenized share class of the Generali Money Market Fund, a Luxembourg fund managed by Generali Asset Management. For now only other Generali group companies can subscribe.
entries.numLabel: assets in the Generali Money Market Fund, per Ledger Insights
entries.mechanism: Fund units in the new class are recorded and managed on distributed ledger technology rather than in a traditional register. Neither report names the blockchain used.
entries.implication: Another European asset manager is putting money market fund units on ledger rails, a format also used for collateral and stablecoin reserves.
evidence: Access is limited to Generali group companies, with wider availability planned gradually

entries.head: SoFi launches SOFIE, an FDIC-insured tokenized deposit paying 4.40% APY
entries.fact: On October 22 SoFi Bank announced SoFi Earn (SOFIE), which it calls the first national bank-issued tokenized deposit for consumers. Each token represents $1 on deposit and pays a variable 4.40% APY as of October 20.
entries.numLabel: variable APY on SOFIE as of October 20, 2026
entries.mechanism: SOFIE is a bank deposit liability held through a SoFi Crypto account, not a payment stablecoin. Members can convert it 1:1 into SoFiUSD to buy crypto or send funds to external wallets around the clock.
entries.implication: A deposit that earns interest and still converts to a stablecoin on demand puts bank deposits and onchain dollars in one product.
evidence: Insured up to $250,000 per depositor, per insured bank, per ownership category, under FDIC rules

Rollout to SoFi Crypto members runs through November 2026

entries.head: Boerse Stuttgart wins a DLT trading and settlement licence for its Seturion platform
entries.fact: On October 20 Boerse Stuttgart Group said BaFin granted it a DLT Trading and Settlement System licence under the EU DLT Pilot Regime, after a process with ESMA and the ECB. The group says it is the first European exchange group to hold one.
entries.numLabel: current DLT Pilot Regime cap per infrastructure, per Ledger Insights
entries.mechanism: Seturion lets banks, brokers and trading venues settle tokenized assets on public or private blockchains, against onchain money or central bank money. Venues connected to it can offer tokenized trading without their own DLT licence.
entries.implication: A licensed shared settlement layer lets more European firms offer tokenized trading without building their own, though the volume cap still limits scale.
evidence: Partners named: flatexDEGIRO, Nasdaq, Societe Generale and SG FORGE
The group claims connected banks and brokers could cut costs by up to 90%; this is a company claim

No production launch date has been announced

entries.head: OCC finalizes GENIUS Act stablecoin rule, easing proposed reserve liquidity and maturity limits
entries.fact: On October 21 the Office of the Comptroller of the Currency issued its final rule implementing the GENIUS Act for payment stablecoin issuers it supervises, effective January 18, 2027. It sets a 5% daily liquidity floor and drops the proposed weekly liquidity test and 20-day maturity cap.
entries.numLabel: minimum reserve share in demand deposits or Fed balances; was 10%
entries.mechanism: Issuers must back each stablecoin with reserve assets of at least equal value, redeemable within two business days. The final rule now ties liquidity to a 5% cash-like floor and a 40% single-counterparty limit rather than a maturity cap.
entries.implication: Final reserve and redemption rules give bank and nonbank issuers a fixed US standard ahead of January 2027, which matters for stablecoins used as settlement cash for tokenized assets.
evidence: Reserves of at least 5% in demand deposits, payable-on-demand share accounts or Federal Reserve balances, down from 10% proposed in February
Weekly liquidity requirement and the 20-day weighted average maturity limit are not in the final text; the 40% single-counterparty limit stays
Redemptions may not take longer than two business days after the request
Proposed presumption that affiliate or third-party payments breach the yield ban is dropped; the ban on issuer-paid yield remains

entries.head: Bank Negara Malaysia launches SSDS+, a depository for tokenized bonds and sukuk
entries.fact: On October 20 Bank Negara Malaysia (BNM) launched SSDS+, an in-house platform to issue, record and safekeep tokenized bonds and sukuk (Islamic bonds). It extends the Scripless Securities Depository System, the central depository for the wholesale market.
entries.numLabel: settlement in central bank money via RENTAS+, linked to SSDS+
entries.mechanism: SSDS+ keeps ownership and transfer records for tokenized securities on cloud and distributed ledger technology. The matching cash payment settles through RENTAS+, BNM's real-time gross settlement system, in central bank money.
entries.implication: A central bank now runs the ledger for tokenized government and retail bonds, with cash settling at any hour. No issuance on it has been reported yet.
evidence: Built in-house by BNM on cloud and distributed ledger technology
Integrated with RENTAS+, the 24/7 interbank settlement system that launched in October 2025
Ready to support tokenized government and retail bonds, per Digital News Asia; neither it nor Fintech News Malaysia reports an issuance yet

entries.head: J.P. Morgan's JPM Coin deposit token goes live on Ethereum mainnet
entries.fact: On October 19 Kinexys, J.P. Morgan's blockchain unit, made its USD deposit token JPM Coin (JPMD) available on Ethereum, a Layer 1 network. The token had been live on Base, an Ethereum Layer 2, since November 2025.
entries.numLabel: cumulative Kinexys transactions (bank's internal data, all services)
entries.mechanism: JPMD is a token representing a claim on U.S. dollar deposits at J.P. Morgan, not a reserve-backed stablecoin. It is available to the bank's institutional clients, who can transfer it peer to peer across Ethereum and Base.
entries.implication: A bank deposit token now sits on the same chain as tokenized funds, giving institutions a bank-issued cash leg for onchain settlement and collateral.
evidence: Available to J.P. Morgan institutional clients on Ethereum and Base

entries.head: First Abu Dhabi Bank settles an AED 1B digital green bond on Euroclear's D-FMI

entries.numLabel: size of the three-year digitally native green notes
entries.mechanism: The notes are issued, distributed and settled on Euroclear's Digital Financial Market Infrastructure, which uses distributed ledger technology and connects to existing secondary-market services. The notes are expected to list on the Abu Dhabi Securities Exchange.
entries.implication: A bank issuer moved a listed bond's issuance and settlement onto a ledger while keeping familiar market plumbing, a pattern now repeating on D-FMI.

entries.head: RWA.xyz shows $39.23B of distributed tokenized assets, up 1.21% in 30 days
entries.fact: RWA.xyz's dashboard, checked on October 19, listed $39.23B in distributed asset value, up 1.21% from 30 days earlier. Total asset holders reached 5,309,446, up 15.31% over the same period.
entries.numLabel: distributed asset value on RWA.xyz, checked October 19
entries.mechanism: RWA.xyz separates distributed assets, which are issued and transferable onchain, from represented assets, which are recorded onchain but held off the chain's own rails.
entries.implication: Holder counts grew about 15% in 30 days while distributed value rose about 1%, so recent growth is in participants more than in dollars.

entries.head: Nine companies object to OKXICE tokenizing their shares under the SEC exemption
entries.fact: OKXICE's October 15 public notice lists nine issuers that have objected to trading of their tokenized stock on its venue, including Broadcom, CoreWeave, Verizon and UnitedHealth. The notice gives no reasons.
entries.numLabel: issuers that had objected to OKXICE as of its October 15 notice
entries.mechanism: Under the SEC's September 17 exemption, a venue must notify the issuer of a stock tokenized by an unaffiliated third party and give it a chance to object before trading. OKXICE runs permissioned Uniswap v4 pools on X Layer, open only to wallets holding a soulbound token it issues.
entries.implication: Issuers can now say no to a specific venue, which makes company consent a practical limit on third-party tokenized equities.
evidence: Eight of the nine were among the 63 tickers OKXICE named on October 4; Cerebras was not, per The Block
Per The Block, Applied Optoelectronics told the Wall Street Journal it was unsure how tokenization would affect its price, liquidity and volatility
OKXICE is owned 50/50 by Intercontinental Exchange and OKX's U.S. holding company; the notice says it does not issue or tokenize the stocks traded
The notice gives no launch date

entries.head: Iberdrola, BBVA and Santander run a €150M syndicated loan entirely on a shared ledger
entries.fact: On October 15, BBVA and Santander announced a €150 million syndicated loan for Iberdrola whose full lifecycle, from disbursement to maturity, is administered on a distributed ledger platform built by ioBuilders. The banks describe it as the first live loan managed this way.
entries.numLabel: syndicated facility administered end to end on the ledger
entries.mechanism: Interest notices, principal and fee payments, covenant monitoring, consents and transfers of loan participations are recorded on the shared ledger and visible in real time to authorized participants. This replaces reconciliation between each bank's separate databases.
entries.implication: Loan administration, long manual, becomes a test of shared-ledger records; the release does not say whether the network is public or permissioned.
evidence: Platform developed by ioBuilders with BBVA and Santander; Gómez-Acebo & Pombo advised on legal terms
An appointed agent bank keeps operational control, per BBVA
The banks plan to onboard more participants and add features
Maturity and use of proceeds were not disclosed

entries.head: Brazil's CVM opens a simulated pilot to test tokenized securities on DLT networks
entries.fact: Brazil's securities regulator CVM published Resolution 249 on October 14, creating a pilot to test the full securities lifecycle on distributed ledger networks. Trials use test tokens and fictitious data, with no real investors or assets.
entries.numLabel: test period, extendable by 30 days
entries.mechanism: Industry associations and self-regulatory bodies in CVM's Tokenization Working Group propose test networks. Inside them CVM can suspend rules on offering registration, custody and settlement, and reads each network in real time through an access node.
entries.implication: A regulator-run sandbox lets market infrastructure trial tokenization before any rule change, with participants' final reports meant to suggest legal changes.
evidence: Network proposals are due within 15 business days of publication
Eligible assets include shares, debentures, receivables certificates and fund quotas, per Capital Aberto
Private and permissioned public networks are both allowed
Per Ledger Insights, CVM Chair Otto Lobo said the pilot will help weigh tokenization's opportunities and risks

entries.head: Ripple Prime opens 24/7 swaps on 100+ stock, metal and currency markets, with Virtu trading
entries.fact: On October 15 Ripple Prime launched swaps for institutional clients that track more than 100 markets across equities, indices, ETFs, metals, energy and currencies. Each swap references a perpetual futures contract that Trade.xyz lists on Hyperliquid, and Virtu is already trading them.
entries.numLabel: reference markets covered by the swaps
entries.mechanism: Ripple Prime takes the other side of each swap as principal, so clients never trade on Hyperliquid directly. Positions sit in one prime account, can be cross-margined with other assets, and can be collateralized with Ripple’s RLUSD stablecoin where available.
entries.implication: Onchain perpetual markets are now reachable through a regulated-style prime broker, extending round-the-clock price exposure to traditional assets without tokenizing the assets themselves.
evidence: Trading and settlement run 24/7, including weekends
Offered under Ripple Prime’s Credit Intermediation Vehicle (CIV) license in the British Virgin Islands; other regions planned, no dates given
RLUSD collateral availability may vary by jurisdiction
Clients gain price exposure only, not ownership of the referenced assets

entries.head: EBA classifies USDC as the first significant e-money token under MiCA
entries.fact: On October 14 the European Banking Authority classified Circle’s USDC as a significant e-money token, the first of 45 notified in the EU. From November 12 the EBA takes over supervision of its reserves, own funds and liquidity from France’s ACPR.
entries.numLabel: EU e-money tokens notified under MiCA; USDC is first significant
entries.mechanism: Under the EU’s MiCA rules, a significant token falls under dual supervision: the EBA covers own funds, reserve assets, liquidity and recovery and redemption plans, while the national regulator keeps governance and related areas.
entries.implication: Stablecoins used as settlement cash for tokenized assets are gaining a single EU-level prudential supervisor, which sets a reference point for reserve and liquidity oversight.
evidence: EBA keeps reassessing significance each year
ACPR retains governance, qualifying holdings, fit-and-proper checks, outsourcing and conflicts of interest
EBA signed a memorandum of understanding with the New York State Department of Financial Services on cross-border stablecoin oversight

entries.head: Perpetuals.com files notice for a tokenized-stock venue under the SEC innovation exemption
entries.fact: On October 14 Kephas Corporation, a Perpetuals.com subsidiary, published a notice for a Tokenized Securities Venue that relies on the SEC’s September 17 innovation exemption. The venue has not started trading and the notice gives no start date.
entries.numLabel: term of the SEC innovation exemption the venue relies on
entries.mechanism: Trading would run through permissioned automated market maker pools on Kronos X Public, an Ethereum-compatible layer-2 network, each pairing a tokenized stock with a form of USDC. Smart contracts set prices instead of an order book.
entries.implication: Alongside the OKXICE filing, the SEC’s exemption is moving from rule text to venue notices, with tokenized stocks trading on public blockchains the next test.
evidence: The notice cites SEC Release No. 34-106402 and says the venue is not registered with the SEC for activities under the exemption
The SEC order requires trading in a tokenized stock to halt when the underlying stock halts on its primary exchange
The SEC order requires smart contracts to be auditable, public and deployed on a public, permissionless blockchain
CoinDesk reports trading could begin in mid-November at the earliest

entries.head: BNY and Citadel Securities use a tokenized Treasury as collateral in a triparty repo
entries.fact: BNY said it completed a tokenized U.S. Treasury triparty repo with Citadel Securities, announced October 13. Citadel bought a 2-year Treasury note on Tradeweb, and BNY recorded a tokenized version that settled within minutes instead of the standard T+1.
entries.numLabel: standard settlement cycle; the tokenized note settled within minutes
entries.mechanism: BNY recorded a token of the Treasury note on its private digital ledger, then Citadel pledged it as collateral for an overnight loan of cash from BNY. The same asset moved from purchase to financing without waiting for the usual next-day settlement.
entries.implication: The test moves tokenization from issuance toward collateral use, where faster settlement frees cash. BNY says digital cash and tokenized deposits are next.
evidence: Citadel then used the token as overnight collateral and received cash from BNY
BNY calls it the first use of tokenized assets on a major triparty repo platform; the release does not name the platform
BNY did not disclose the trade size or repo rate
BNY plans digital cash and tokenized deposit tools, and longer settlement hours covering Europe and Asia next year

entries.head: Federated Hermes and Prometheum plan tokenized funds for brokerage accounts, first in Q1 2027
entries.fact: On October 13 Federated Hermes and Prometheum announced a partnership to issue and distribute tokenized securities funds through Prometheum’s SEC-registered, FINRA-member broker-dealer infrastructure. They expect the first tokenized fund in Q1 2027.
entries.numLabel: expected timing of the first tokenized fund
entries.mechanism: Prometheum’s broker-dealer arms would custody, clear and settle the tokenized fund shares and offer them to introducing broker-dealers through a correspondent clearing platform. The aim is to reach standard brokerage accounts rather than crypto-native platforms.
entries.implication: Distribution through ordinary brokerage channels is a different route from crypto-native platforms, but no fund, chain or eligibility terms are set yet.
evidence: Federated Hermes reported $911.6B in assets under management as of June 30, 2026
ProFinancial, a Prometheum unit, supports distribution
The release gives no fund name, blockchain, size or investor eligibility

entries.head: BNY Institute: Treasury settlement should run around the clock, with 24/7 clearing targeted for 2027
entries.fact: On October 13 BNY Institute published a paper arguing that Treasury settlement, funding and collateral must move toward always-on operation. BNY says it will extend settlement hours later in 2026 and target 24/7 clearing for traditional and tokenized Treasuries in 2027.
entries.numLabel: Treasury activity unsettled at the end of each day, per BNY
entries.mechanism: Tokenized securities, cash and collateral can carry rules inside settlement, so a collateral transfer can trigger automatically against a margin requirement or a financing leg. BNY adds that this still needs funding, collateral and balance sheet capacity.
entries.implication: A major custodian is placing tokenized Treasuries as a second rail inside Treasury settlement, alongside longer hours on existing systems.
evidence: Treasury venues can be open up to 22 hours a day, while about $239B of activity stays unsettled at each day's end
Roadmap: longer settlement hours for Fed-eligible assets later in 2026, then European and Asian hours in 2027
2027 targets include 24/7 bilateral and triparty financing across traditional and tokenized assets
Digital cash options named: tokenized money market funds, tokenized deposits and stablecoins

entries.head: Derivnex completes first OTC total return swap on Canton, between DRW and Marex
entries.fact: On October 13 Derivnex and Canton Network announced a total return swap between DRW and Marex Solutions referencing the iBoxx USD Liquid Investment Grade Index, tokenized by Kaiko. The release calls it the first OTC derivative on a fully tokenized index; that is the companies' own claim.
entries.mechanism: The trade's terms sit in a smart contract on Canton that both counterparties share, so valuations and other lifecycle events update one synchronized record instead of two reconciled ones. The reference index is itself a token, valued from official index data supplied by Kaiko.
entries.implication: Tokenization is extending from cash assets to derivative contracts and benchmark data, with collateral integration named as the next step.
evidence: Swap provider is Marex Solutions; counterparty is DRW
Kaiko distributed S&P Dow Jones Indices official index values used to value the position
Derivnex uses the Common Domain Model, a standard supported by ISDA
Next: equity and index derivatives, then digital cash and collateral on Canton

entries.head: TRON DAO reports $93.88B of USDT and USDD supply on TRON and $2.21T settled in Q3
entries.fact: TRON DAO's State of TRON Q3 2026 report, published 12 October, says stablecoin settlement on the network reached $2.21T in Q3, with USDT and USDD supply at $93.88B, up 5.5% from Q2.
entries.numLabel: USDT and USDD supply on TRON, Q3 2026 (TRON DAO)
entries.mechanism: Stablecoin supply and settlement volume show how much dollar-denominated value moves on a chain, which is the cash leg that tokenized assets settle against.
entries.implication: The figures are the issuer-network's own and unaudited here; read them as a signal of stablecoin activity, not an independent measure.
evidence: Average daily settlement volume rose 3.9% from Q2 to $24.05B, per the TRON DAO report as carried by NewsBTC.
TVL was $28.21B including staking and $13.05B excluding it (TRON DAO).
The piece is a TRON DAO press release distributed via BlockmanPR; the figures are not independently verified.

entries.head: Morgan Stanley now eyes Q1 2027 to support tokenized equities, after earlier H2 2026 target
entries.fact: Morgan Stanley's head of digital asset strategy, Amy Oldenburg, told The Block at Token2049 that support for tokenized equities on its trading system is now expected in Q1 2027; in March she pointed to the second half of 2026.
entries.numLabel: New target to support tokenized equities at Morgan Stanley
entries.mechanism: A bank can only support trading in tokenized shares once issuers have put suitable securities onchain. Oldenburg tied the delay to thin product supply and to open items such as DTCC's tokenization service, due at the end of October.
entries.implication: A large US bank is pushing back a timeline because tokenized product supply and market plumbing are not yet in place; adoption looks gated by infrastructure.
evidence: Oldenburg said client demand is limited because the product does not yet exist (The Block).
She cited DTCC's tokenization service launch at the end of October 2026 as a milestone the firm is watching (The Block).
She said the Clarity Act not passing is a factor, as is Federal Reserve permissibility (The Block).
crypto.news adds that she expects tokenized RWAs within a $3T-$10T range by 2030; this is her view, not a desk forecast.

links.t: crypto.news: Morgan Stanley sees tokenized assets at $3T-$10T by 2030

entries.head: Report: Stellar now hosts more tokenized assets than the XRP Ledger, at $3.5B vs $2.5B
entries.fact: 24/7 Wall St. reported on Oct 11 that Stellar holds about $3.5B in tokenized real-world assets versus $2.5B on the XRP Ledger, with Solana near $3B.
entries.numLabel: Tokenized assets on Stellar, per 24/7 Wall St.
entries.mechanism: Chain-level RWA totals depend on the aggregator and on what counts as a tokenized asset, so rankings can differ between data providers.
entries.implication: Single secondary source; the article names no data provider or as-of date, so the figures and their basis are unverified.
evidence: 24/7 Wall St. puts Stellar at $3.5B and the XRP Ledger at $2.5B in tokenized assets.
The article cites Solana at $3B and Avalanche at $1.7B.
It does not name its data source or give an as-of date for the totals.

entries.head: Nasdaq CEO: tokenization could unleash tens of billions of dollars in trapped capital
entries.fact: CNBC reports that Nasdaq’s CEO said tokenization could unleash tens of billions of dollars in trapped capital.
entries.mechanism: The claim concerns capital locked up by settlement delays and limited collateral mobility, the friction that on-ledger settlement is meant to reduce.
entries.implication: A second exchange operator in a week is framing tokenization as a capital-efficiency story. The desk could read only the headline at filing, so the figure and its basis are unverified; see the CNBC article.
evidence: The desk could read the headline only; the full article was not accessible at filing

entries.head: Securitize launches 1:1-backed tokenized stocks on Solana
entries.fact: On October 8 Securitize launched tokenized U.S. stocks backed 1:1 by shares held at Securitize Markets’ regulated brokerage, using a Convertible Entitlement Token structure. The tokens run on Solana, settle in USDC, and are open to eligible investors in the U.S., the EU and other jurisdictions.
entries.numLabel: backing by underlying shares held at a regulated brokerage
entries.mechanism: Holders receive shareholder rights, dividends and corporate-action entitlements through the token, and can move to an issuer-sponsored share structure if the issuer adopts one.
entries.implication: The entitlement lives in the token. Alongside the SEC’s September 17 exemption and the OKXICE filing, tokenized stocks are moving from announcement to product.
evidence: Initial names include Apple, Microsoft, Nvidia, Alphabet, Tesla, Meta and Amazon; SpaceX, Palantir, Circle and Strategy are expected
Extended U.S. market hours at first, with plans to expand toward 24/7 trading
CEO Carlos Domingo: “Tokenized stocks should give investors more than a price that happens to track a stock.”
Tokenized stocks had passed $3B of onchain value

links.t: Crowdfund Insider: global availability

entries.head: IMF: tokenized markets are about $65B against $300T of traditional assets
entries.fact: An analytical chapter of the IMF’s Global Financial Stability Report, as reported on October 8, puts tokenized real-world assets at about $65B against roughly $300T of traditional capital-market assets, and names four barriers: legal certainty, regulatory clarity, interoperability and settlement assets.
entries.numLabel: tokenized RWAs per the IMF, vs. about $300T in traditional capital markets
entries.mechanism: Two of the four barriers concern the rules around the token: whether holders can enforce the rights it represents, and how existing regulation applies to new ledgers.
entries.implication: The “settlement assets” barrier, a lack of safe and widely accepted money for settling trades, bears directly on native stablecoins such as TX’s announced USTX.
evidence: More than half of tokenized trading happened outside regular market hours
About 80% of the tokenized equity trades analyzed were for less than one share
Repo makes up most tokenized activity: roughly $300–350B of daily transactions, against about $13T of daily U.S. repo volume
The IMF says tokenized markets “remain inactive and more volatile than their traditional counterparts” and warns that scale could amplify fire sales and contagion

source.n: The Coin Republic, reporting the IMF Global Financial Stability Report

links.t: Genfinity coverage

entries.head: Fidelity’s Horne: the line between TradFi and onchain may vanish into “just finance”
entries.fact: On a panel at Longitude Singapore on October 8, Matthew Horne, a Fidelity digital-asset strategy lead, said the gap between traditional and onchain finance might disappear, leaving what he called “just finance.”
entries.mechanism: The remark is about convergence: as assets and settlement move onto shared ledgers, “onchain” stops being a separate market.
entries.implication: Fidelity already offers onchain products, including tokenized exposure to money-market funds and U.S. Treasurys, so the comment comes from an operator, not an observer.
evidence: Reporter’s paraphrase: institutional assets are moving onchain quickly, and U.S. asset managers are motivated mainly by investor access and new markets

entries.head: OKXICE files to trade tokenized shares of 63 NYSE-listed companies
entries.fact: OKXICE LLC, a joint venture between OKX and NYSE parent Intercontinental Exchange, filed with the SEC on October 4 to offer tokenized shares of an initial 63 NYSE-listed companies, pending approval, under the SEC’s new innovation exemption.
entries.numLabel: NYSE-listed companies in the initial offering, pending approval
entries.mechanism: Issuers have 30 days to opt out before trading can begin, and tokenized securities must carry full shareholder rights such as dividends and voting.
entries.implication: The September 17 exemption now has its first filings: the venue, the opt-out window and the holder-rights conditions are written into the launch path.
evidence: ICE took a stake in OKX in March in a deal valuing the crypto firm at $25B
OKXICE co-chair Andrew Cuomo: “This is 24-hour, global stock market trading and has enormous advantages.”
Launch timing depends on the 30-day opt-out period and other requirements

links.t: Bloomberg

entries.head: Two aggregators, two totals: $46.2B at Token Terminal, $38.61B at RWA.xyz
entries.fact: Token Terminal put tokenized real-world assets at about $46.2B across 35 to 36 networks in late September, excluding stablecoins. RWA.xyz showed $38.61B across 39 networks on October 1. The gap reflects methodology, including how distributed assets and cross-chain representations are counted.
entries.numLabel: gap between the two totals
entries.mechanism: Whether a token can move off the issuing platform decides which total it lands in.
entries.implication: Quote the aggregator and its definition together. The desk’s headline stays RWA.xyz distributed value.
evidence: Token Terminal: Ethereum about $22.2B (48%), BNB Chain $5.5B, Stellar and zkSync Era $3.3B each, Solana $3.0B
Categories: U.S. Treasury bills about $13.9B, active yield strategies $10.7B, credit funds $6.5B; tokenized stocks added about $592M in 30 days
Only about 7% to 12% of tokenized assets are used in DeFi
